cases.question: Tell me about Pdfroo
cases.judge_reason: All specific claims in the answer are supported by or consistent with the expected facts, with no invented or contradicted details.
cases.answer: Pdfroo is Ayush's private PDF editor that runs entirely in your browser — no uploads, no backend. You can open a PDF, annotate, sign, rearrange or merge pages, then download a flattened PDF. It works offline once loaded and supports phones, tablets, and desktops with mouse, pen, or touch. Built with pdf.js and pdf-lib, it uses SortableJS for drag-to-reorder pages and includes features like rotate, duplicate, delete, and insert blank pages. After editing, you get a little kangaroo toast saying your PDF never left your device. Live demo: https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/. Repo: https://github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo. No build step, no install — just open index.html or serve it statically.
